title: Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Model Inference via Per-Query Modality Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.31768v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) can jointly process a broad range of modalities, such as text, audio, and video, enabling stronger multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, but often at substantial inference cost. We observe that the benefit of additional modalities varies across queries, indicating that a fixed modality configuration can be inefficient. Motivated by this, we study query-wise modality selection, which keeps the underlying Omni-LLM fixed while adaptively selecting which modalities to provide for each query. We formulate the problem as an accuracy-cost optimization problem and develop a cost-sensitive learning approach for modality selection. We evaluate our approach on WorldSense using Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni under three inference-cost measures: input tokens, latency, and monetary cost. translated_title: 通过逐查询模态选择实现高效的全模态大语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLM）能够联合处理文本、音频和视频等多种模态，实现更强的多模态理解与推理能力，但往往伴随着高昂的推理成本。我们观察到，额外模态带来的收益因查询而异，这表明固定的模态配置可能效率低下。基于此，我们研究了逐查询的模态选择方法，即在保持底层全模态大语言模型不变的情况下，自适应地为每个查询选择需要提供的模态。我们将该问题形式化为精度-成本优化问题，并开发了一种用于模态选择的成本敏感学习方法。我们在WorldSense数据集上，使用Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni模型，在输入token数、延迟和货币成本三种推理成本度量下评估我们的方法。在两个模型上，逐查询模态选择均持续改善了精度-成本的权衡表现。
tldr: 提出一种逐查询自适应模态选择方法，在不改动全模态大语言模型本身的情况下，通过成本敏感学习为每个查询选择最优模态组合，持续改善精度与推理成本之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: Proposes a per-query adaptive modality selection method with cost-sensitive learning that keeps the Omni-LLM unchanged while consistently improving the accuracy-cost trade-off across token, latency, and monetary cost measures.
